algorithm: Baseline joint two-hand+object pose estimation: YOLOv2-backbone fully convolutional network extended from Tekin et al. predicting 3D grids of per-cell pose vectors for left hand, right hand, and object simultaneously; baseline action recognition: TA-GCN (graph-based, with interconnection/attention terms)
hand: MANO (two-hand parametric mesh model, both left and right hands fit per frame, 21-joint skeleton mapped to OpenPose convention)
headline_metric: Interaction (verb-noun) action recognition accuracy (%), TA-GCN baseline
headline_value: 86.78% val / 79.25% test accuracy (Table 4-right), best among compared methods (C2D, I3D, SlowFast, H+O, ST-GCN)
human_data: 571,645 egocentric RGB-D frames, 4 subjects, 8 objects, 3 environments (hall/office/kitchen), captured with 5 synchronized Azure Kinect DK cameras (4 static + 1 head-mounted); MANO two-hand pose + 6D object pose + camera pose + verb-noun action labels (36 classes) annotated per frame
note_gaps: No sequence count given anywhere in the parsed text (only frame counts); no explicit licence statement found; not a robot dataset so arm/sim/hand_dof/real_robot fields are not applicable to a physical embodiment.
